title: Cold Slate — Hardware Keynote Hero
description: A hardware-launch hero built around a centered 3D device render floating above a soft graphite gradient floor. Mono sans product name, a pill-shaped availability chip, and a restrained brand wordmark replicate the DJI and Rivian product-reveal cadence without a single decorative detour.
philosophy: This template exists for the precise moment a physical product must speak entirely for itself. It refuses ornamentation, refuses multi-column layout, and refuses any typographic weight that could compete with the render. The design assumes a darkened conference hall, a high-lumen projector, and an audience that flew in to see one thing — the device. Negative space is the primary design material; everything else is subtraction.
goodFor: Single-product hardware launches — phones, drones, EVs, wearables
Keynote title cards accompanied by a finished 3D render asset
"Available [Date]" teaser reveals before a full feature breakdown
Product-page visual language adapted for a projected stage environment
avoidFor: Feature-dense spec sheets requiring callout labels
SaaS or service pitch decks with no physical hero object
Slides requiring embedded charts, graphs, or data tables
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The atmosphere evokes a darkened conference hall at the precise moment a product is unveiled — deep graphite space swallows the background while the device floats above a soft luminous floor gradient, commanding the eye through isolation rather than decoration. Compositional rhythm is radial and gravitational: all visual mass collapses inward toward the render, with every surrounding element receding into near-silence. The mood is cinematic restraint — cold, precise, and confident in the way DJI and Rivian stage physical objects. Avoid warmth, busyness, or any decorative gesture that could fracture the single-object focus.

examples.layoutNotes: Single-column centered layout with no grid divisions — the 3D device render occupies the optical center of the canvas, tall enough to dominate the vertical axis, with an implied gradient floor shadow bleeding downward to the bottom edge. Product name locks directly beneath the render in one tight baseline, followed immediately by a pill-shaped availability chip. Brand wordmark sits flush to the bottom margin with equal dead-air padding on all outer edges; no header band, no page number, no side columns.

examples.promptCore: A single feature-reveal moment: one dominant label fills the vertical center like a stage spotlight cutting through a darkened hall, surrounded on all sides by intentional void. The mood is the quiet confidence of an engineer presenting one sentence to a silent room — DJI spec-drop energy, Rivian launch-event stillness. Composition breathes asymmetrically in the vertical axis, the text block floating slightly below true center to feel grounded rather than suspended. Avoid decorative dividers, avoid icon grids, avoid anything that implies a list — this slide earns its authority through ruthless subtraction.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid; the content block occupies cols 4–9, vertically centered with roughly 30% of the slide height left empty above it. A single hairline rule separates a large hero feature label from a one-line descriptor beneath it — hierarchy achieved through scale contrast alone, no secondary columns. Page number anchors bottom-right at the outer margin; brand wordmark sits bottom-left at the same baseline. No header band, no sidebar, no icon row.
